Messages.Author: Analnatrach
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

Well I was very surprised to see such a strong set of cards, this set
really opens a lot of new possibilities...

For some who are curious here are some expanations of some of the
cards :

All Independent clans now have a 11-cap vampire who are RARE cards (so
last in the booster and giving you 4 vamps in that booster) :

Ur Shulgi, assamite (!)
Esmeralda, Ravnos ( best of all, you can burn her to gain 11 pool
!!!!)
Sutekh, The Dark God, Setites !!!
I forgot the name of the Giovanni :) but she can get cards back from
ashheap
and something more

An artifact that gives you superior Thaumaturgy
An artifact that gives you superior Necromancy AND WITH IT YOU CAN GET
CARDS BACK FROM ASHHEAP !!!

so GIOVANNI are great ... why ... well one card only does it !!
--> SHAMBLING HORDES... cost you 3 blood from the vamp, it requires
necromancy , it has strength equal to it's life which is FOUR, it can
never gain life, it can attack any minion as D-action ... not
unique...

so SETITES are great, why ?
Venenation : Action modifier if vamp is blocked he gains corruption
counter..;
Enticement : Only usable if you control the edge, burn it as d-action
to cause prey to lose 2 pool/ 3 pool on SUP, after this you can no
longer bleed for the turn.

some more cards then :

DEFLECTION GETS IT's ASS KICKED why ?
-> Contingency Planning , Master: out-of-turn, but it can be played in
your turn. Burn a minion card that would change the target of the
bleed as it is played, after playing this card if the bleed is
succesful the bleed is reduced to 1. only usable when minion you
control is bleeding

--Treasured Samadji
unique, equipment requires ravnos
Ravnos get +1 bleed and may dodge as a strike once per combat

King of the mountain
fortitude, cost 2
prevent all damage from minion's strike if he uses a melee weapon it
is destroyed
SUP : oppossing minion gets equal damage as he inflicts, but you can
still prevent his damage ( with another card)

For those who read the clannovels :

Calebros, The Martyr
Cammarilla Prince of New York
obf,pot,ANI; 5 CAP
any older camarilla vamp can steal his title which calebros can't
block

Tariq, The Silent
Independent
cel,AUS,FOR,OBF,QUI, 7 CAP
his CAP is reduced to 3 if he enters play, can enter combat as
D-action, bloodhunt has no effect on him, he is not affected with
Bloodcurse

THIS IMO is A VERY GOOD VAMPIRE

Anatole, Prophet of gehenna
dom,for,AUS,DEM,OBF
+1 intercept
you may look and shuffle top 5 cards of your library

oh yes before i forget , Dreams of the Sphinx can be found in the
GIOVANNI starter...

Enjoy Final nights, I alrfeady have...

greetings,

Steven

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Steven wrote:
>>All Independent clans now have a 11-cap vampire who are RARE cards (so
last in the booster and giving you 4 vamps in that booster) :>>

Are these actually Rare? That strikes me as really dumb.

>>DEFLECTION GETS IT's ASS KICKED why ?
-> Contingency Planning , Master: out-of-turn, but it can be played in
your turn. Burn a minion card that would change the target of the
bleed as it is played, after playing this card if the bleed is
succesful the bleed is reduced to 1. only usable when minion you
control is bleeding>>

As I mentioned earlier, I'm just not seeing this card as all that handy. It
only works when your own minions are Deflected (so it doesn't protect you from
your Predator's Deflections) and it reduces your bleed to 1. Yeah, I suppose it
keeps you from bleeding out your grand prey (at the cost of 1 pool per
bleed...) if you expect a lot of Deflections from your prey, but I hardly see
this as the game changer people seem to be building it up as.

>>oh yes before i forget , Dreams of the Sphinx can be found in the
GIOVANNI starter...>>

Along with The Parthenon, Ambrosious, Command of the Beast and a few other good
ex-rare cards. The Giovanni starter is A) really good in a limited game
environment and B) full of really good cards you want anyways.
